meeting.title: Ashby embedded analytics — weekly sync
meeting.summary: Weekly sync on the Ashby embedded analytics rollout. Agreed sandbox setup with signed JWT auth, the customer_id claim work on Ashby's side, and a write-up of the row-level filtering approach.
action_items: Theo to set up embed sandbox with signed JWT auth and share credentials by June 24
Ruben to expose customer_id claim in session token on staging by June 26
Maya to send row-level filtering write-up for multi-tenant embeds by June 25
key_decisions: Embeds authenticate via signed JWTs minted by Ashby's backend, not shared links
meeting.notes: Ashby wants hiring dashboards inside their recruiting product for their own customers — tenant isolation is the make-or-break requirement.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Hi both — today is all embedded analytics. Elise, want to restate the goal so we're aligned?

transcript.speaker: Elise Vandamme
transcript.text: Sure. We want each of our recruiting customers to see their own dashboards inside our product — their pipeline, their time-to-hire, nobody else's. Tenant isolation is non-negotiable.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Understood. The right pattern here is signed JWTs: your backend mints a short-lived token per user, the token carries the tenant identity, and the embed respects it.

transcript.speaker: Ruben De Smet
transcript.text: That works for us — we already issue session tokens, we'd just extend the claims.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Good. Let's make it concrete. Theo, can you stand up a sandbox they can develop against?

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Yes — I'll set up the embed sandbox with signed JWT auth and share credentials by Wednesday, June 24th.

transcript.speaker: Ruben De Smet
transcript.text: Then the ball is with me. I'll expose the customer_id claim in our session token — deployed to staging by Friday, June 26th.

transcript.speaker: Elise Vandamme
transcript.text: One question — how does the customer_id claim actually filter the data? Is that per dashboard or global?

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Global, enforced at the semantic layer, so a dashboard can't accidentally leak across tenants. I'll write up the row-level filtering approach for multi-tenant embeds and send it over by Thursday the 25th.

transcript.speaker: Elise Vandamme
transcript.text: Great, I'd like our security folks to read that before we go further.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Sensible. The write-up plus the sandbox should give them everything they need to poke at it.

transcript.speaker: Ruben De Smet
transcript.text: It might be worth load-testing the embeds eventually, but let's see it working first.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Agreed — load testing is a later conversation. So: sandbox Wednesday, write-up Thursday, staging claim Friday. Reconvene next Monday?
